Subject: Redwood x Procurely — Vendor onboarding & PO path (kickoff)

Hi Hannah (and team),

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday — excited to get Procurely into Redwood's vendor ecosystem. I've attached our standard vendor intake packet and a fillable W-9 to speed things up. To keep the kickoff lightweight, below is what we typically need from Redwood and what we'll provide up-front: 

What we need from Redwood (quick list you can action):
- PO recipient and remit address (full legal name + address)
- Redwood preferred PO terms (net30/net45, purchase order number format)
- Billing contact (name + email + phone)
- Any invoicing reference requirements (SOW numbers, project codes)
- Vendor onboarding portal access (if you require us to upload docs into your vendor portal)

What Procurely will provide to Redwood:
- Completed vendor intake packet (attached)
- Signed W-9 (attached)
- Certificate of insurance (attached)
- Bank details (we can provide via secure link or DocuSign)

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick 30-min sync to confirm PO flow and required fields — are you available Tue/Wed this week?
2) We send completed forms and DocuSign for banking info once we confirm the billing contact.
3) You confirm PO cadence and we cut an initial PO to validate invoicing.

Attachments: Procurely_Vendor_Intake.pdf (fillable), Procurely_W9.pdf, Procurely_Insurance_Cert.pdf

If there are any mandatory vendor checks (SOC2 evidence, data processing addenda, or privacy questionnaires) let me know and we’ll add them to the packet before the call.

Best,
Tom Evans
Head of Partnerships
Procurely, Inc.
T: +1 415-555-0132
E: tom.evans@procurely.com

Tom — thanks for the materials and clear checklist. Quick confirmation from our side: happy to proceed. A few Redwood-specific notes to help the intake go smoothly: 

- PO terms: Redwood Finance prefers net30 by default; if you need net45 we can escalate for approval (may affect payment run timing).
- Remit address: Redwood Inference, Inc. | 450 Mission St. | San Francisco, CA 94105 — please use exactly as shown on the PO.
- Billing contact: AccountsPayable <ap@redwoodinference.com> (primary), and I'll be the operational lead during onboarding (hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com).
- Invoicing: please include the PO number on the invoice header and reference the HubSpot company id when available.

Regarding vendor checks: we will need your SOC 2 type II report or a SOC attestation summary if you host customer data, and a standard DPA (I attached a template link below). If Procurely stores or processes Redwood customer data, please flag that so our Security team can route a short questionnaire.

I'm free Wed 11/24 10:00-10:30 AM PT or Thu 11/25 2:00-2:30 PM PT for the kickoff call — pick one and I'll send a calendar invite.

For the initial PO test, we typically do a low-value invoice to validate routing — we can accept an invoice for $1 to confirm.

Thanks,

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
ap@redwoodinference.com | +1 650-555-0199

Links: DPA template — https://redwoodinference.sharepoint.com/sites/procurement/dpa-template
